name: Barbell Standing Rollout
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart behind a barbell with round rolling plates, hinge at your hips, and grip it shoulder-width overhand.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly while locking your elbows straight.
Roll the bar smoothly forward along the floor until your body extends near a straight plank.
Pull the bar back toward your feet and lift your hips until you are folded over the bar again.
tips: Stop rolling out immediately before your lower back begins to arch or sag.
Keep your arms straight throughout rather than bending your elbows to assist the return.
